card.name: Small words after a drug name subject
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation right after a subject, most often "be" in "[drug] should be discontinued". Also "a" after "is" or a comma, and "(" before a citation.

modes.label: should be discontinued
modes.description: The word "be" after a drug name and "should" in stop-treatment warnings.
modes.example: Levetiracetam Injection should<< be>> discontinued at the first sign of a rash

modes.label: a or ( after a name
modes.description: The word "a" or an opening bracket directly after a drug name or description phrase.
modes.example: EVOTAZ is<< a>> fixed-dose tablet containing 30

modes.label: General text filler
modes.description: Words or punctuation in non-drug text, such as "long" in "as long ago" or a bracket before a scripture reference.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words, mostly the "be" in "should be discontinued" after a drug name.
